newsitem.title: CANADA: JDS FITEL rides high on soaring Q4 profits.
newsitem.headline: JDS FITEL rides high on soaring Q4 profits.

text.p: Shares of JDS FITEL Inc shot up to new 52-week highs on Thursday after the high technology firm reported unexpectdly strong fourth quarter earnings, sparking anticipation of more to come.
"It's just fantastic earnings," said Canaccord Capital analyst Gurinder Parhar. "It's unbelievable growth."

The company, based outside of Ottawa, saw fourth quarter earnings nearly double to C$0.34 a share, on net income of C$8.3 million, for the year ended May 31. A year earlier profit totaled C$0.19 a share or C$4.1 million.
Shares jumped 8.50 to 54 in heavy mid-afternoon trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange after soaring as high as 57 earlier. The old 52-week high was 46.50 and the low 15.85.

Parhar said he anticipates strong long-term growth potential for JDS FITEL, which makes products that increase fiberoptic cable capacity. The demands imposed by the stunning growth of multi-media applications, the world-wide link-up of computers called the Internet, cable stations and more means the industry is expanding by 40 percent a year, Parhar said.
He predicts JDS Fitel will significantly increase earnings and profits in the future, and has set a target price of C$65 a share 12-14 months out.
